name: Launch A — Replay and No-Show Branch

source.primary: If/Else `webinar-attended` vs `webinar-noshow` -> branched replay copy with cart-close countdown.
supporting: Funnel Hacker's Cookbook — Webinar Funnel replay/urgency page with cart-close countdown; Drop-Off Automation for no-shows.
Perfect Webinar Stack recap for attendees who left before the offer.
Honest urgency only — the countdown must match the real cart-close datetime.

purpose: One job: recover the value of the live session after it ends. No-shows get the replay and a reason it matters now. Attendees who did not buy get the stack recap and a door back into the offer. One branch, two messages, one shared deadline.

trigger.what_starts_it: Wait until `webinar_end_datetime` plus 2 hours (configurable 1-4 hours) — after the live room has closed and before attention fades.
trigger.timing: Within hours of the live event; the replay window default is 72 hours, and it must end at the same moment as `cart_close_datetime`.
trigger.branching: If/Else on attendance tags: `webinar-attended` -> attended branch. `webinar-noshow` -> no-show branch. No attendance signal -> no-show branch (the safer assumption; never call a silent contact an attendee).

no_show.subject_angle: "Sorry we missed you — here's the replay (expires [date])"
no_show.body_framework: Acknowledge plainly that they could not make it. Re-sell the promise in one sentence, not the agenda. Embed the replay. Name the real deadline: the replay closes at `cart_close_datetime`. Restate the ONE promise and one thing they will see in the replay. Single CTA.

attended_no_buy.subject_angle: "Did you catch the [offer] at the end?"
attended_no_buy.body_framework: Thank them for attending. Point straight at the part they may have missed: the offer, the stack, the deadline. Embed the replay anchored to the offer segment if the platform supports it. Deadline in one line. Single CTA.

sms.send: One SMS per branch, only with consent, sent with the email
sms.body_framework: No-show: "Missed you — replay here, closes [date]: [URL]". Attended: "Thanks for coming — the offer from the end is here: [URL]". One line.

copy_rules: Never tell a no-show they attended, or an attendee they missed it. The branch exists so the copy never lies.
The replay expiry and the cart close are the same datetime. If they differ, fix the build, not the copy.
Countdown is real: do not extend it silently after sending.
No fake replay-extension emails. One replay window, stated once, honoured.
No-show copy never shames. 'Sorry we missed you' is the tone ceiling.
Attendee copy never re-teaches the webinar; it points at the offer segment.
guards: `webinar-purchased` -> exit before the branch; do not send a replay to a buyer.
`webinar-buy-link-clicked` without purchase -> attended branch even if the attendance tag is missing.
No replay URL -> do not send; surface a build error rather than sending a broken link.
`cart_close_datetime` missing or in the past -> do not send.
Opt-out per channel; SMS DND -> email only.
Session rescheduled after the live send -> replay stays bound to the delivered session; never mix replays from two sessions.

ghl_build.structure: Trigger: Tag Added `webinar-registered` -> Wait until `webinar_end_datetime` + 2h -> If purchased -> End -> If/Else `webinar-attended` OR `webinar-buy-link-clicked` -> Attended replay email -> Else -> No-show replay email -> If SMS consent -> Branch-matched SMS -> Wait until `cart_close_datetime` -> End.
ghl_build.notes: Attendance tags come from the webinar platform webhook or a 'click to join' trigger-link click. Both branches must share one `cart_close_datetime`; the replay page countdown reads the same field. Never let the email cite a deadline the page does not enforce.

scope.includes: Registrants who are not buyers after the live session ends.
excludes: Buyers — routed to onboarding, never messaged here
Cart-close Emotion/Logic/Fear close sequence — separate launch-a files
